title: chore(typescript): setup Jest (part 1)
body:
This is the first step toward our process migrating to TypeScript.

- **Jest**.
  - The Jest configuration has been moved to its own file.
  - It upgrades Jest to version 24 (soon stable) which supports TypeScript by default. The Jest team seems confident enough to [use this alpha version in the React codebase](https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/14634), so I figured let's use it right now. Snapshots have been updated accordingly (a single file needed updates).

- **Renovate**.
  - The Renovate configuration has been moved to its own file.
  - The `types` packages remain unpinned. The corresponding Renovate configuration has been created.
